metadata.name: Aloria Labs — Problem-Specific Outreach Intelligence Library
metadata.purpose: Route every prospect to one evidence-based problem instead of sending generic sales emails.
metadata.core_rule: Never claim the prospect has a problem. Use public signals as a hypothesis, then ask a discovery question.
metadata.recommended_routing: Research company → detect signals → select ONE problem → select decision-maker → personalize evidence → send French first → follow up → qualify → propose discovery/audit after interest.

problems.audit_signals_to_look_for: Recent expansion, hiring, new capacity, new customers or increasing operational complexity, Public evidence of manual work, fragmented tools, delays, errors or weak visibility, Relevant job postings, customer feedback, product/process changes or operational announcements
problems.business_impact: des retards de traitement, un manque de visibilité et davantage de travail manuel
problems.aloria_solution_angle: Diagnostiquer le flux lié à « Production downtime », mesurer les frictions et prioriser les automatisations avec un ROI clair.

fr.subject: Une question sur production downtime
fr.body:
Bonjour {first_name},

Je me permets de vous contacter depuis l’Inde au nom d’Aloria Labs, spécialisée dans la digitalisation, l’automatisation et les systèmes métier.

En regardant votre activité dans le secteur industrial manufacturing, j’ai identifié un point qui peut parfois devenir un frein lorsque l’entreprise grandit : production downtime.

Je ne sais évidemment pas si c’est un sujet chez vous, mais certains signaux peuvent l’indiquer : recent expansion, hiring, new capacity, new customers or increasing operational complexity, public evidence of manual work, fragmented tools, delays, errors or weak visibility, relevant job postings, customer feedback, product/process changes or operational announcements.

Lorsque ce point existe, il peut notamment entraîner des retards de traitement, un manque de visibilité et davantage de travail manuel.

Notre approche consiste d’abord à comprendre le fonctionnement actuel et à identifier les étapes qui pourraient être mieux structurées ou automatisées. Selon le contexte, cela peut passer par un système métier, des intégrations, des tableaux de bord ou de l’IA, sans forcément remplacer vos outils existants.

Est-ce un sujet que vous rencontrez actuellement chez {company}, ou avez-vous déjà une solution en place ?

Si le sujet est pertinent, je serais heureux d’échanger 15 minutes avec vous.

Bien cordialement,
{sender_name}
Aloria Labs
Inde
{website}

en.subject: A question about production downtime
en.body:
Hello {first_name},

I’m reaching out from India on behalf of Aloria Labs, where we work on business digitalisation, automation and operational systems.

While looking at your activity in the industrial manufacturing sector, I noticed one area that can sometimes become a bottleneck as companies grow: production downtime.

I obviously don’t know whether this is an issue for your team, but possible signals include: recent expansion, hiring, new capacity, new customers or increasing operational complexity, public evidence of manual work, fragmented tools, delays, errors or weak visibility, relevant job postings, customer feedback, product/process changes or operational announcements.

When this exists, it can lead to des retards de traitement, un manque de visibilité et davantage de travail manuel.

Our approach is to first understand the current workflow and identify where information, repetitive tasks or operational steps could be structured or automated. Depending on the situation, that may involve a business system, integrations, dashboards or AI, without necessarily replacing existing tools.

Is this something you are currently dealing with at {company}, or do you already have a solution in place?

If relevant, I’d be happy to have a 15-minute conversation.

Best regards,
{sender_name}
Aloria Labs
India
{website}

Bonjour {first_name}, dernier message de ma part. Je voulais simplement savoir si production downtime fait partie de vos priorités actuelles. Si non, aucun souci.

Hello {first_name},

I’m reaching out from India on behalf of Aloria Labs, where we work on business digitalisation, automation and operational systems.

While looking at your activity in the industrial manufacturing sector, I noticed one area that can sometimes become a bottleneck as companies grow: installation/commissioning tracking.

I obviously don’t know whether this is an issue for your team, but possible signals include: recent expansion, hiring, new capacity, new customers or increasing operational complexity, public evidence of manual work, fragmented tools, delays, errors or weak visibility, relevant job postings, customer feedback, product/process changes or operational announcements.

When this exists, it can lead to des pertes de temps, des informations dispersées et des relances difficiles à piloter.

Our approach is to first understand the current workflow and identify where information, repetitive tasks or operational steps could be structured or automated. Depending on the situation, that may involve a business system, integrations, dashboards or AI, without necessarily replacing existing tools.

Is this something you are currently dealing with at {company}, or do you already have a solution in place?

If relevant, I’d be happy to have a 15-minute conversation.

Best regards,
{sender_name}
Aloria Labs
India
{website}

Hello {first_name},

I’m reaching out from India on behalf of Aloria Labs, where we work on business digitalisation, automation and operational systems.

While looking at your activity in the industrial manufacturing sector, I noticed one area that can sometimes become a bottleneck as companies grow: energy monitoring.

I obviously don’t know whether this is an issue for your team, but possible signals include: recent expansion, hiring, new capacity, new customers or increasing operational complexity, public evidence of manual work, fragmented tools, delays, errors or weak visibility, relevant job postings, customer feedback, product/process changes or operational announcements.

When this exists, it can lead to des erreurs, des délais supplémentaires et une difficulté à suivre la performance.

Our approach is to first understand the current workflow and identify where information, repetitive tasks or operational steps could be structured or automated. Hello {first_name},

I’m reaching out from India on behalf of Aloria Labs, where we work on business digitalisation, automation and operational systems.

While looking at your activity in the industrial manufacturing sector, I noticed one area that can sometimes become a bottleneck as companies grow: project reporting.

I obviously don’t know whether this is an issue for your team, but possible signals include: recent expansion, hiring, new capacity, new customers or increasing operational complexity, public evidence of manual work, fragmented tools, delays, errors or weak visibility, relevant job postings, customer feedback, product/process changes or operational announcements.

When this exists, it can lead to des retards de traitement, un manque de visibilité et davantage de travail manuel.

Our approach is to first understand the current workflow and identify where information, repetitive tasks or operational steps could be structured or automated. Depending on the situation, that may involve a business system, integrations, dashboards or AI, without necessarily replacing existing tools.

Is this something you are currently dealing with at {company}, or do you already have a solution in place?

If relevant, I’d be happy to have a 15-minute conversation.

Best regards,
{sender_name}
Aloria Labs
India
{website}
